newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Frances downgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Frances downgraded.

text.p: - Paribas Capital Markets analyst Carlos Gomez-Lopez Thursday downgraded Banco Frances to "no action" from "buy".
- Gomez-Lopez said "although we are fully confident of the growth potential of Argentine banks, at 2.5x book value and 2.6x adjusted book value, Frances' shares are close to fully valued."
- The company's shares have gained 51 percent in the last five months, and are now trading within two percent of their historic highs.
- Gomez-Lopez added any rally on the back of the strong Q2 results should be used as a chance to take profits.
